FrontierLargeTuple.lean:
import D1Bound5.FrontierLargeNumeric

open scoped NumberField Matrix.Norms.L2Operator BigOperators
open Matrix Module

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The sharpened FOUR-entry frontier gap: an ordered D(1)-quadruple
whose smallest modulus is at least three has T>3ABS. It follows from
the proved product-four constant two and a more precise entrywise use
of the already-established adjugate estimates. -/
theorem IsD1Tuple.frontier_large_growth
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    (a : Fin 4 → 𝓞 K) (ha : IsD1Tuple a)
    (hmon : Monotone (fun i => ‖phi (a i : K)‖))
    (hA : 3 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖) :
    3*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ <
      ‖phi (a 3 : K)‖ := by
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  let w : Fin 4 → ℂ := fun i => f (a i)
  let A := ‖w 0‖
  let B := ‖w 1‖
  let C := ‖w 2‖
  let D := ‖w 3‖
  have hB : 3 ≤ B := hA.trans (hmon (by decide : (0 : Fin 4) ≤ 1))
  have hC : 3 ≤ C := hB.trans (hmon (by decide : (1 : Fin 4) ≤ 2))
  change 3 ≤ A at hA
  have hAB : 9 ≤ A*B := by
    nlinarith only [hA, hB, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hA) (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)]
  have hfirst : 2*A*B*C < D :=
    IsD1Tuple.productFour_large_growth hK phi a ha hmon hA
  have h18 : 18*C < D := by
    nlinarith only [hfirst, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAB) (show 0 ≤ C by linarith)]
  have hD : 54 ≤ D := by linarith only [h18, hC]
  have hw (i : Fin 4) (hi : i ≠ 3) : ‖w i‖ ≤ D/18 := by
    have hsmall : ‖w i‖ ≤ C := hmon (by omega : i ≤ 2)
    linarith only [hsmall, h18]
  obtain ⟨M, hdiag, hsym, hroot⟩ := ha.exists_symmetric_root_matrix a
  have hlarge (i j : Fin 4) (_ : i ≠ j) : 9 ≤ ‖f (a i)*f (a j)‖ := by
    have hi : 3 ≤ ‖f (a i)‖ := hA.trans (hmon (Fin.zero_le i))
    have hj : 3 ≤ ‖f (a j)‖ := hA.trans (hmon (Fin.zero_le j))
    rw [norm_mul]
    nlinarith only [hi, hj, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hi) (sub_nonneg.mpr hj)]
  obtain ⟨u,S,hu,hd,hs,_,hsq,hgood⟩ :=
    exists_good_symmetric_root_matrix_with_roots f a M hdiag hsym hroot hlarge
  let F := normalizedRootError w u (S.map f)
  have hzero (i : Fin 4) : F i i = 0 :=
    normalizedRootError_diag w u (S.map f) hu (fun j => congrArg f (hd j)) i
  have hsymF (i j : Fin 4) : F i j = F j i := by
    change u i*f (S i j)*u j-f (a i)*f (a j) =
      u j*f (S j i)*u i-f (a j)*f (a i)
    rw [hs i j]
    ring
  have hnear (i j : Fin 4) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      ‖F i j-(1/2 : ℂ)‖ < (128/8649 : ℝ) := (hgood i j hij).2
  have hG := frontier_large_adjugate_entry_bounds F hzero hsymF hnear
  have hFnear : ‖F-halfOffDiagonal‖ < 3*(128/8649 : ℝ) :=
    signed_root_matrix_operator_bound f a u S hu hd hgood
  have hF : F.det ≠ 0 := reference_perturbed_det_ne_zero_of_near F hFnear
  have hdet : ‖F.det‖ < (1/4 : ℝ) :=
    (signed_root_matrix_det_upper f a u S hu hd hs hgood).trans
      (by unfold productFourH productFourS; norm_num)
  have hupper := frontier_large_rankOne_det_bound F w D hD hF hdet hG hw rfl
  have hmatrix : F+Matrix.vecMulVec w w = scaledRootMatrix u (S.map f) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      F, w, normalizedRootError, scaledRootMatrix, Matrix.map_apply]
    ring
  have hlower := full_ring_scaledRootMatrix_det_norm_lower hK phi
    (by decide : Even (Fintype.card (Fin 4))) a S hd hsq u hu
  have hlower' : A*B*C*D ≤ ‖(F+Matrix.vecMulVec w w).det‖ := by
    rw [hmatrix]
    convert hlower using 1
    simp [A, B, C, D, w, f, Fin.prod_univ_four]
  have hmul : (3*A*B*C)*D < D*D := by nlinarith only [hlower', hupper]
  change 3*A*B*C < D
  by_contra hn
  have hnonneg := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_gt hn))
    (show 0 ≤ D by linarith only [hD])
  nlinarith only [hmul, hnonneg]

end D1Bound5
RetainedFourScalar.lean:
import D1Bound5.RetainedGapScalar

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The first summand of the actual four-anchor form is below one percent
after the retained five-entry growth has been established. -/
theorem retained_four_first_term_lt
    (A B S T C D Z : ℝ) (hA : 3 ≤ A) (hB : 3 ≤ B)
    (hS : 0 < S) (hT : 0 < T) (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hC : 16*B*S*T < C)
    (hD : A^2*C^5/S^2 < D)
    (hroot : (3999/4000 : ℝ)*C*D < Z^2) :
    13*B*S^2*T^3/Z < (1/100 : ℝ) := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hC0 : 0 < C := (by positivity : 0 < 16*B*S*T).trans hC
  have hC6 : (16*B*S*T)^6 < C^6 := by
    gcongr
  have hD' := (div_lt_iff₀ (pow_pos hS 2)).mp hD
  have hD'' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hD'
    (by positivity : 0 < (3999/4000 : ℝ)*C)
  have hroot' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hroot (pow_pos hS 2)
  have hC6' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hC6
    (by positivity : 0 < (3999/4000 : ℝ)*A^2)
  have hbig : (3999/4000 : ℝ)*A^2*(16*B*S*T)^6 < Z^2*S^2 := by
    nlinarith only [hC6', hD'', hroot']
  have hAB : (729 : ℝ) ≤ A^2*B^4 := by
    calc
      (729 : ℝ) = 3^2*3^4 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ A^2*B^4 := by gcongr
  have hcoef : (10000*169 : ℝ) < (3999/4000 : ℝ)*16^6*(A^2*B^4) := by
    nlinarith only [hAB]
  have hcoef' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcoef
    (by positivity : 0 < B^2*S^6*T^6)
  have hsquare : (100*(13*B*S^2*T^3))^2 < Z^2 := by
    apply (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right (pow_pos hS 2)).mp
    nlinarith only [hcoef', hbig]
  have hlinear : 100*(13*B*S^2*T^3) < Z := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : Z ≤ 100*(13*B*S^2*T^3) := le_of_not_gt h
    have hp := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 100*(13*B*S^2*T^3)+Z)
    nlinarith only [hp, hsquare]
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hZ).2
  nlinarith only [hlinear]

/-- Final retained-start scalar contradiction: the actual nonzero four-anchor
form forces the seventh-power terminal gap. Its assumptions are the concrete
form estimate and previously obtained fifth-power growth, not the conclusion. -/
theorem retained_four_start_scalar_gap
    (A B S T C D Z L : ℝ) (hA : 3 ≤ A) (hB : 3 ≤ B)
    (hS : 0 < S) (hT : 0 < T) (hSC : S ≤ C) (hTC : T ≤ C)
    (hC1000 : 1000 < C) (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hC : 16*B*S*T < C)
    (hD : A^2*C^5/S^2 < D)
    (hrootlo : (3999/4000 : ℝ)*C*D < Z^2)
    (hroothi : Z^2 ≤ C*D+1)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hupper : L < 13*B*S^2*T^3/Z + (49/50 : ℝ)*S*T^2*Z/(A*C^4)) :
    A^2*C^7/(S^2*T^4) < D := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hSn : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  have hTn : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  have hfirst := retained_four_first_term_lt A B S T C D Z
    hA hB hS hT hZ hC hD hrootlo
  have hsecond : (99/100 : ℝ) < (49/50 : ℝ)*S*T^2*Z/(A*C^4) := by
    linarith only [hL, hupper, hfirst]
  have hclean := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < A*C^4)).mp hsecond
  let Y := A*C^4/(S*T^2)
  have hY : 0 < Y := by dsimp [Y]; positivity
  have hZlower : (99/98 : ℝ)*Y < Z := by
    dsimp [Y]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < S*T^2)).2
    nlinarith only [hclean]
  have hYC : C ≤ Y := by
    dsimp [Y]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < S*T^2)).2
    have hp : C*(S*T^2) ≤ C*(C*C^2) := by gcongr
    have hA1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ A := by linarith
    have ha := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA1 (pow_nonneg hC0.le 4)
    nlinarith only [hp, ha]
  have hY1000 : 1000 < Y := hC1000.trans_le hYC
  have hYsquare : (1000000 : ℝ) < Y^2 := by
    nlinarith only [hY1000, sq_nonneg (Y-1000)]
  have hmargin : (1 : ℝ) < ((99/98 : ℝ)^2-1)*Y^2 := by
    nlinarith only [hYsquare]
  have hZsquare : (99/98 : ℝ)^2*Y^2 < Z^2 := by
    have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hZlower)
      (by positivity : 0 < Z+(99/98 : ℝ)*Y)
    nlinarith only [hp]
  have hCD : Y^2 < C*D := by
    nlinarith only [hmargin, hZsquare, hroothi]
  apply (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left hC0).mp
  have heq : C*(A^2*C^7/(S^2*T^4)) = Y^2 := by
    dsimp [Y]
    field_simp [hSn, hTn]
  rw [heq]
  exact hCD

end D1Bound5
